title: Payment Service Runbook
content: If payment-service reports elevated latency, first check database connection pool saturation via get_service_health. If pool acquisition time exceeds 5 seconds, this indicates connection pool exhaustion. Recommended action: check for long-running transactions holding connections, then consider a controlled service restart during a maintenance window. Do not restart production without on-call approval.

title: Database Recovery Guide
content: Database connection timeouts are commonly caused by pool exhaustion, network partition, or a runaway query holding locks. Check active connection count and long-running query list first. If connection acquisition exceeds 5 seconds consistently, escalate as SEV-2. Do not kill production connections without confirming no in-flight write transactions.

title: Kubernetes Troubleshooting Guide
content: Pod CrashLoopBackOff is usually caused by a failing readiness probe, missing config map, or OOMKilled events. Check `kubectl describe pod` for the exact reason before taking action. Scaling replicas up does not fix a crash loop and should not be used as a first response.

title: Security Escalation Policy
content: Any request involving credential exposure, unauthorized access, or a suspected breach must be escalated to the security on-call immediately and must never be resolved automatically by an agent. Agents must refuse to take direct remediation action on security incidents beyond initial classification and evidence-gathering.

title: Service Ownership Catalogue
content: payment-service is owned by the Payments team, on-call rotation in PagerDuty schedule PAY-ONCALL. database-cluster-prod is owned by the Platform Data team. kubernetes-prod is owned by the Platform Infra team.

title: Previous Incident Report - INC-4821
content: INC-4821: payment-service P95 latency rose to 3s during a Black Friday traffic spike. Root cause was database connection pool saturation combined with retry amplification from a downstream bank API timeout. Resolution: increased connection pool size and added circuit breaker on the bank API client. Duplicate Kafka events were also observed due to retries without idempotency keys.

title: Old Restart Procedure (Obsolete)
content: DEPRECATED as of 2025-01-01, superseded by rb-001. Old procedure: restart payment-service immediately on any latency spike without checking root cause. This procedure is no longer approved and must not be followed.
